summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 2 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.50/2306)

data.turoyo: ʕAmmo Išoʕ: Qamayto kəzzən lu ḥṣodo, annaqqa kətwo ḥa nuqalwo šuxre, hən mənayye ḥəṣdiwo, hən mənayye mulanwo aš šuxre w annaqqa nəqliwo li adro, hul d maxləṣiwo. Hən mənayye b iḏayye ḥəšfiwo w hən mənayye bu magzuno baṣ ṣʕore. Aṣ ṣʕore duwenwo ʕloye bu magzuno, duwanwo nəḥute b iḏayye. W mulanwo aš šuxre w nəqliwo.
data.translation: Uncle Isho: First they go to the harvest. Then there was someone who would carry the grain frames; some would reap, some would fill the grain frames, and then they would carry them to the threshing floor until they finished. Some would pull it up with their hands, and some with the sickle, with the barley. If the barley was tall, with the sickle; if it was short, with their hands. And they would fill the grain frames and carry them.

rationale: Only attestation of hand-harvesting sense 2; full context preserves the contrast with the sickle and crop-height condition.
